Class Habitat

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.Habitat

  • public class Habitat
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a Habitat in the zoo with a name, environment type, and area. A habitat can contain up to 10 animals.

      • Habitat

        public Habitat(java.lang.String id,
               java.lang.String name,
               EnvironmentType environment,
               double area,
               int maxCapacity)
        Constructs a Habitat object with the specified name, environment, and area.
        Parameters:
        id - The code of the habitat.
        name - The name of the habitat.
        environment - The type of environment in the habitat (e.g., aquatic, terrestrial, avian).
        area - The area of the habitat in square meters.
        maxCapacity - The maximum capacity of the habitat.

    • Method Detail

      • addAnimal

        public boolean addAnimal(Animal myAnimal)
        Adds an animal to the habitat if there is available space. Preconditions: - The `myAnimal` parameter must not be null. - The 'myAnimals' list must be initialized. Postconditions: - If the habitat is not full, the animal is added to the `myAnimals` list.
        Parameters:
        myAnimal - The animal to be added to the habitat.
        Returns:
        true if the animal was successfully added, false if the habitat is full.

      • hasAnimals

        public boolean hasAnimals()
        Checks if the habitat contains any animals.
        Returns:
        true if the habitat has at least one animal, false otherwise.

      • getAnimalList

        public java.lang.String getAnimalList()
        Retrieves a list of animals in the habitat as a formatted String. Preconditions: - The 'myAnimals' list must be initialized. Postconditions: - A String representation of the animals in the habitat is returned.
        Returns:
        A formatted String containing the list of animals in the habitat.
